column1: #   platform  name  version  license  url  archive  member  sha256  binary  status
# member  : path inside the archive ("-" for raw downloads)
# sha256  : upstream digest. "RECORD-ON-FETCH" means upstream publishes no clean
#           digest; fetch-components.sh computes and records one for review and
#           the component stays status=pending until a human confirms it.
# Reproducibility (section 65): never substitute "latest". Bump a version here,
# re-run build/fetch-components.sh, and commit the resulting digests.
# The components below publish no official static Linux binary. Bundling them
# means choosing a third-party build, which is a supply-chain decision the
# operator must make explicitly (sections 25, 26, 38, 39). Until a source is
# chosen the engine's fallback hierarchy (section 62) uses the host copy and
# reports the capability as DEGRADED rather than failing.
